title: For Armor Purposes
description: Fixes Minecraft armor progression and adds a few utility features as well!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/152c3b1c7432d3d5988efdba1e2e60f53b548f64.png)

# **_Mod Features/Guide_**

**UPDATE:**
1. Emerald helmet trim now ALSO makes villager trades restock every 3 minutes instead of every 20 minutes.
2. Netherite Armor that is fully timmed with netherite will cause enemies to drop their weapon when they hit you.


This mod adds: 

- Leather armor has a new simplified tier based trading system
- Thorns IV and V enchantments for chainmail armor only
- Gold armor can now be enchanted with Protection and Fire Protection at the same time
- Iron armor can now stack projectile, blast, and general protection enchantments in all 4 pieces
- Item that allows you to switch between armor sets from anywhere around your world
- Armor trims now come with perks to help you with tasks and progression.
- Elytras can now be crafted into Armored Elytras using metallic materials.

These features overhaul the Minecraft progression system by incentivizing players to use an adventure based play style as opposed to straight forward get diamonds and beat the game. Playing this mod how it was meant to be played gives players the chance to explore all the different structures in Minecraft while simultaneously progressing through the mod/game, meanwhile exploration in vanilla Minecraft tends to halt your progression instead.

Incentivized progression system:



_Enter your world with the goal to collect as many armor trims as possible. Throughout your many adventures to different structures trying to find the trims, you will simultaneously progress through the game by collecting resources as well so you can craft, enchant, and trim the Nether Exploration Set(Gold), TANK set(Iron), and Spelunker's Revenge Set(Chainmail). Once you have collected enough trims to maximize your armor sets and do the high tier leatherworker trade 4 times, you will have enough diamonds to craft a full set of diamond gear(armor and tools). After that, you can either go for netherite armor OR directly go beat the Ender Dragon and finish the game. The choice is up to YOU!_

**How the Perk system works:**

Armor Trim Perks (Any Armor Piece)
- Copper Trim: Adds +0.5 armor toughness and +1.0 armor points
- Iron Trim: Adds +1.0 armor toughness and +1.5 armor points
- Diamond Trim: Adds +2.0 armor toughness and +2.0 armor points
- Netherite Trim: Adds +3.0 armor toughness and +3.0 armor points

**Helmet-Only Perks**
- Master Barterer(Gold Trim): Improves Piglin bartering results, providing better trades with Piglins
- Rich Man(Emerald Trim): Grants Hero of the Village effect, improving trades with villagers
- Glow in the Dark(Redstone Trim): Provides dynamic lighting around the player in dark areas
- Bookworm(Lapis Trim): Lowers level requirements in enchanting tables
- Zoom(Amethyst Trim): Allows you to use the zoom feature without needing a spyglass in your inventory
- Experienced Survivor(Quartz Trim): Increases your XP Gain speed from 1.0 to 3.0(200%)

This system adds strategic value to armor trims beyond aesthetics, allowing players to choose trims based on their playstyle and current needs. This adds a whole new layer to progression as well, end game now has an actual progression stage to get the F.A.F.O set and officially have the strongest possible armor in the game. For modpacks, it is helpful for more difficult structures and bosses you'll face without even needing to use modded armor, in fact, you'll find the F.A.F.O set surpasses most modded armor sets.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How the leather trading tier system works:**


🏆 NEW THREE-TIER SYSTEM

Tier 1 (Highest) - 1 Diamond Block

Requirements: Wearing full dyed + trimmed leather armor set (all 4 pieces)
Method: Wear full set → Empty hand → Shift+right-click villager
Consumed: Entire equipped armor set
Reward: 1 diamond block

Tier 2 (Middle) - 1 Emerald Block

Requirements: Single dyed + trimmed leather armor piece
Method: Hold piece → Shift+right-click villager
Consumed: 1 piece
Reward: 1 emerald block

Tier 3 (Base) - 5 Emeralds

Requirements: Wearing full dyed leather armor set (no trim needed)
Method: Wear full set → Empty hand → Shift+right-click villager
Consumed: Entire equipped armor set
Reward: 5 emeralds

The Portable Armor Incubator is a new item you can get from trading 1 emerald block with an armorer villager. Simply walk up to the armorer with an emerald block in hand, shift + right-click him with it and boom, the PAI is in your possesion!



As the name suggests, this allows you to store all your different armor sets in one portable item so that you can switch from set to set in just a few clicks from anywhere around your world.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Armored Elytras:**

<summary>Spoiler</summary>

</details>



You can now craft armored elytra variants by placing an elytra in the center of a crafting table and surrounding it by 1 of four materials: Copper Ingot, Iron Ingot, Diamond or Netherite SCRAPS. These variants will match their respective material's chestplate armor, no need to constantly switch your elytra for chestplates now! Elytra's are also now enchantable with Protection I-IV as well!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_**|Incompatibilities|**_ Basically compatible with anything but any mod that contradicts any feature or that overhauls the same feature is incompatible. Example of this: Easy Magic mod is incompatible with the Bookworm(Lapis Lazuli) Armor Trim Perk because it changes the behavior/functionality of the enchanting table. YOU CAN STILL PLAY THE MOD, but you will miss out on that feature. 




This mod is now complete with an overhauled progression system for Minecraft. Enjoy :)
